_comment: Sokoban GAME rules (ADR 0009). The metagame layer: scoring, win conditions, restart. Subscribes to world/physics.json events. Without these rules the world still runs (player walks, walls block, boxes push) — but there's no goal. game/rules.json is what makes the world a *game*.

rules._comment: Track move count — subscribe to physics's player_moved signal. Decoupled from physics so a 'move-counter-free' game variant could omit this rule.
Restart input: R reloads the current level. world.current_level is the engine-managed binding to the current level id.
Win check — when a box overlaps a goal, fire transition_level next. Past the last level, engine sets world.all_levels_complete=1 → HUD wins.
